# Episode 4 winter audio sources

These six local MP3s use sources released under [Creative Commons Zero 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). They combine natural recordings and realistic foley. The original horse hoof and neigh recordings remain unchanged. Source pages and their CC0 declarations were checked on 2026-11-13.

| Shipped file | Source and author | Preparation and intended use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `winter-ambient.mp3` | [Winter wind.wav](https://freesound.org/people/Elanor1995/sounds/688841/), Elanor1995 | Exterior field recording of winter wind. A quiet 24.2-second edit with filtered low rumble and a 1.8-second head/tail crossfade for looping. No music is mixed into this bed. |
| `winter-snow.mp3` | [Walking on snow sound](https://opengameart.org/content/walking-on-snow-sound), IgnasD | Two recorded snow-crunch steps are alternated and softly edited into a three-second layer beneath the supplied hoof recording. This is footfall foley, not a new recording of a galloping horse. |
| `winter-ice.mp3` | [ice cracking](https://freesound.org/people/getwecked/sounds/764657/), getwecked | Actual ice-tray cracking recorded with a Zoom H1. Short filtered edit with a gentle decay for ice cages and magical ice impacts. |
| `winter-wings.mp3` | [Owl Hoot](https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/465697/), Breviceps; [Large Wings Flap](https://opengameart.org/content/large-wings-flap), AntumDeluge, based on [dave.des's chop foley](https://freesound.org/s/127197/) | Quiet recorded owl call mixed under three soft wing flaps. The call is an animal recording; the wings are foley rather than a field recording of a flying snowy owl. |
| `winter-herd.mp3` | IgnasD's [snow recordings](https://opengameart.org/content/walking-on-snow-sound); [Horse(snort)_3.wav](https://freesound.org/people/o_ciz/sounds/475483/), o_ciz | Snow-crunch foley and a subdued horse snort represent the fantasy reindeer herd. This mix is not presented as a field recording of real reindeer. |
| `winter-mammoth.mp3` | [R01-33-Elephant Snort.wav](https://freesound.org/people/craigsmith/sounds/479813/), Craig Smith | Gentle elephant breaths/snorts from the author's CC0 historical sound-effects preservation collection. A short, softened section at its original pitch serves as mammoth animal foley; it is not a recording of an extinct mammoth. |

All exports are 44.1 kHz mono MP3 at 96 kbit/s. Edits use trimming, crossfades, filtering, level control and mixing. The wind loop stays quiet; effects retain headroom for the game mix. The game applies its independent background/effects controls and limiter.

Verified exports: wind 24.2 s, snow/herd/wings 3.0 s each, ice 1.5 s, mammoth 2.8 s. Encoded peak levels stay below -4 dBFS; wind mean level is approximately -27 dBFS.
